records.objectives_text: Kill Dr. Boom and return with the good news to Lead Sapper Blastfizzle at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: The Sunfury Garrison
records.objectives_text: Custodian Dieworth at Kirin'Var Village wants you to kill 10 Sunfury Archers.

records.name: Down With Daellis
records.objectives_text: Custodian Dieworth at Kirin'Var Village wants you to kill Master Daellis Dawnstrike.

records.name: Essence for the Engines
records.objectives_text: Collect 7 Mana Wraith Essences and return them to Chief Engineer Trep at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Report to Engineering
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Etherlithium Matrix Crystals to Chief Engineer Trep at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Elemental Power Extraction
records.objectives_text: Extract 5 Elemental Power for Chief Engineer Trep at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: I See Dead Draenei
records.objectives_text: Speak to Ramdor the Mad, standing on the bone pile outside of the Auchenai Crypts.

records.name: Ezekiel
records.objectives_text: Find and speak with Ezekiel of Shattrath in Shattrath City.

records.name: Decipher the Tome
records.objectives_text: Take the Mysterious Tome to Althen the Historian in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: The Battle Horn
records.objectives_text: Take the Unyielding Battle Horn from Lieutenant Commander Thalvos and bring it to Althen the Historian in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: What Book? I Don't See Any Book.
records.objectives_text: Ezekiel said the book has been stolen. Your best bet is to find the Ruffians and see if they have any information.

objectives.text: Beat Down "Dirty" Larry and Get Information

wiki.page: What Book? I Don't See Any Book.

records.name: In A Scrap With The Legion
records.objectives_text: Kill 5 Mo'arg Doomsmiths and 15 Gan'arg Engineers. Then return to Papa Wheeler at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

wiki.page: In A Scrap With The Legion

records.name: Torching Sunfury Hold
records.objectives_text: Using a Flaming Torch, destroy 4 Sunfury Ballistas and 4 Sunfury Tents and return to Lieutenant-Sorcerer Morran at Kirin'Var Village.

records.name: One Demon's Trash...
records.objectives_text: Gather 10 Fel Reaver Parts and return them to Mama Wheeler at the Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Declawing Doomclaw
records.objectives_text: Obtain Doomclaw's Hand and deliver it to Mama Wheeler at the Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Outland Sucks!
records.objectives_text: Find 6 Shredder Parts and return to Foreman Razelcraz by the mine northwest of Thrallmar.

records.name: Warn Area 52!
records.objectives_text: Deliver the bad news to Rocket-Chief Fuselage at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: How to Serve Goblins
records.objectives_text: Rescue Manni, Moh and Jakk from the Fel Orc camps and return to Foreman Razelcraz by the mine northwest of Thrallmar.

records.name: Potential Energy Source
records.objectives_text: Lieutenant-Sorcerer Morran at Kirin'Var Village wants you to capture 10 Energy Isolation Cubes from the blood elf operations at Manaforge Coruu.

records.name: Building a Perimeter
records.objectives_text: Use the Rune Activation Device near the East Rune, Northeast Rune, and West Rune. The runes can be found around the perimeter of Kirin'Var Village's Wizard Row and Town Square districts. Return to Lieutenant-Sorcerer Morran once you've completed the task.

records.name: Distraction at Manaforge B'naar
records.objectives_text: Slay 8 Sunfury Magisters and 8 Sunfury Bloodwarders and return to Exarch Orelis at Area 52. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: Spinebreaker Post
records.objectives_text: Apothecary Zelana at Reaver's Fall wants you to speak with Wing Commander Brack to take a wyvern to Spinebreaker Post, and then bring the Bleeding Hollow Blood Sample to Apothecary Albreck at Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: Naaru Technology
records.objectives_text: Go inside Manaforge B'naar and find the B'naar Control Console. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: B'naar Console Transcription
records.objectives_text: Deliver the B'naar Console Transcription to Anchorite Karja at Area 52 in Netherstorm. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: Attack on Manaforge Coruu
records.objectives_text: Travel to Manaforge Coruu and slay 8 Sunfury Arcanists and 5 Sunfury Researchers. Return to Exarch Orelis when you've completed this task. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Doctor Vomisa, Ph.T.
records.objectives_text: Speak with Doctor Vomisa, Ph.T. at the Proving Grounds in Netherstorm.

records.name: You, Robot
records.objectives_text: Activate the Scrap Reaver X6000 Controller and test out its capabilities. Then give your feedback to Doctor Vomisa, Ph.T at the Proving Grounds in the Netherstorm. Deal with any problems that arise.

records.name: Back to the Chief!
records.objectives_text: Report to Rocket-Chief Fuselage at Area 52 in the Netherstorm immediately!

records.name: Bloody Vengeance
records.objectives_text: Blow the Unyielding Battle Horn near the Alliance Banner. Kill Urtrak and then return to Althen the Historian at Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: The Master's Grand Design?
records.objectives_text: Find Nitrin the Learned at the Abandoned Armory in Nagrand.

records.name: Vision of the Dead
records.objectives_text: Nitrin at the Abandoned Armory in Nagrand wants you to bring him 1 Mountain Gronn Eyeball, 1 Flawless Greater Windroc Beak, and 1 Aged Clefthoof Blubber.

records.name: Levixus the Soul Caller
records.objectives_text: Destroy Levixus and take the Book of the Dead from his possession. Deliver the Book of the Dead to Ramdor the Mad standing outside the Auchenai Crypt entrance of Auchindoun. You had a deal, remember?

records.name: Force Commander Danath
records.objectives_text: Marshal Isildor wants you to report to Force Commander Danath Trollbane in Honor Hold.

records.name: Testing the Antidote
records.objectives_text: Use the Cenarion Antidote on a Hulking Helboar and observe the results. Once you have the results of the experiment, return to Thiah Redmane at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Capturing the Keystone
records.objectives_text: Venture into Tempest Keep's Botanica and retrieve The Keystone from Commander Sarannis. Bring it to Archmage Vargoth at The Violet Tower.

records.name: Honor the Fallen
records.objectives_text: Report to Commander Hogarth in the Expedition Armory.

records.name: Into the Breach
records.objectives_text: Kill 6 Invading Felguards and then return to Argent Emissary Proudwell.

records.name: WANTED: Annihilator Servo!
records.objectives_text: Obtain an Annihilator Servo and deliver it to Papa Wheeler at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: A Heap of Ethereals
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Zaxxis Insignias and return them to Nether-Stalker Khay'ji at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Assisting the Consortium
records.objectives_text: Speak with Nether-Stalker Khay'ji at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Assisting the Consortium
records.objectives_text: Speak with Nether-Stalker Khay'ji at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Consortium Crystal Collection
records.objectives_text: Obtain an Arklon Crystal Artifact and return it to Nether-Stalker Khay'ji at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Request for Assistance
records.objectives_text: Seek out and offer your services to Gahruj. He is located at the Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Rightful Repossession
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Boxes of Surveying Equipment and return them to Gahruj at the Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm in the Netherstorm.

records.name: An Audience with the Prince
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Surveying Equipment to the Image of Nexus-Prince Haramad at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Triangulation Point One
records.objectives_text: Use the Triangulation Device to point your way toward the first triangulation point. Once you have found it, report the location to Dealer Hazzin at the Protectorate Watchpost on the Manaforge Ultris island in the Netherstorm.

records.name: A Not-So-Modest Proposal
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Teleporter Power Pack and bring it to the Ethereal Teleport Pad on the Celestial Ridge to the east of Manaforge Ultris. Activate the pad and give the Teleporter Power Pack to the Image of Wind Trader Marid so he can install it.

records.name: Getting Down to Business
records.objectives_text: Gather 8 Nether Dragon Essence, then return to the Ethereal Teleport Pad area. Nether Dragon Essence may be obtained from Nether Drakes or Nether Dragons.

records.name: A Promising Start
records.objectives_text: Gather 15 Nether Dragonkin Eggs, then return to Tyri and Jorad on the Celestial Ridge.

records.name: Troublesome Distractions
records.objectives_text: Speak with Wind Trader Marid and lure him away from his trading post. Deal with him and then return to Tyri and Jorad on the Celestial Ridge.

records.name: Securing the Celestial Ridge
records.objectives_text: Use the Challenge of the Blue Flight to provoke Veraku on the southern edge of the Celestial Ridge. Defeat him and return to Tyri and Jorad on the Celestial Ridge.

records.name: Triangulation Point Two
records.objectives_text: Use the Triangulation Device to point your way toward the second triangulation point. Once you have found it, report the location to Wind Trader Tuluman at Tuluman's Landing, just on the other side of the bridge from the Manaforge Ara island in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Full Triangle
records.objectives_text: Recover the Ata'mal Crystal and deliver it to the Image of Nexus-Prince Haramad at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.

records.name: The Caverns of Time
records.objectives_text: Andormu at the Caverns of Time has asked that you follow the Custodian of Time around the cavern.

records.name: The Warp Rifts
records.objectives_text: Use the :Unstable Warp Rift Generator in the Warp Fields. Gather 3 Warp Nethers from Unstable Voidwalkers and return them to Ogath the Mad in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: To The Master's Lair
records.objectives_text: Speak to Andormu at the Caverns of Time.

records.name: Special Delivery to Shattrath City
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Ata'mal Crystal to A'dal on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

records.name: Formal Introductions
records.objectives_text: Find Tyri at the north end of the Celestial Ridge and speak with her.

records.name: Old Hillsbrad
records.objectives_text: Andormu at the Caverns of Time has asked that you venture to Old Hillsbrad and speak with Erozion.

records.name: Taretha's Diversion
records.objectives_text: Travel to Durnholde Keep and set 5 incendiary charges at the barrels located inside each of the internment lodges using the Pack of Incendiary Bombs given to you by Erozion. Speak to Thrall in the basement prison of Durnholde Keep when you have the Internment Lodges Set Ablaze.

records.name: Escape from Durnholde
records.objectives_text: When you are ready to proceed, let Thrall know. Follow Thrall out of Durnholde Keep and help him free Taretha and fulfill his destiny. Speak with Erozion in Old Hillsbrad should you complete this task.

records.name: Return to Andormu
records.objectives_text: Return to the child Andormu at the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris desert.

records.name: Arelion's Secret
records.objectives_text: Magistrix Carinda wants you to interrogate Magister Aledis, last seen traveling from Falcon Watch to Zangarmarsh.

records.name: The Mistress Revealed
records.objectives_text: Return to Magistrix Carinda at Falcon Watch.

records.name: Arrival in Outland
records.objectives_text: Commander Duron at the Dark Portal in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to bring Duron's Report to Amish Wildhammer.

records.name: Journey to Thrallmar
records.objectives_text: Take Vlagga Freyfeather's Wind Rider to Thrallmar. Bring Orion's Report to General Krakork.

records.name: In Search of Farahlite
records.objectives_text: Gather 4 pieces of Raw Farahlite and return to Zuben Elgenubi at the Stormspire.

records.name: Report to Nazgrel
records.objectives_text: General Krakork in Thrallmar wants you to speak with Nazgrel.

records.name: Hitting the Motherlode
records.objectives_text: Zuben Elgenubi at the Stormspire wants you to obtain a Farahlite Core.

records.name: Void Ridge
records.objectives_text: Go to Void Ridge and kill the creatures you find. Collect 40 Void Ridge Soul Shards and return them to Ogath the Mad in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: From the Abyss
records.objectives_text: Kill Void Baron Galaxis and collect his soul shard. Take the shard to Ogath the Mad in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: The Black Morass
records.objectives_text: Travel through the Caverns of Time to the Black Morass during the opening of the Dark Portal and speak with Sa'at.

records.name: The Opening of the Dark Portal
records.objectives_text: Sa'at inside the Black Morass of the Caverns of Time has tasked you with defending Medivh until he succeeds in opening the Dark Portal. Return to Sa'at should you succeed in your task.

wiki.page: The Opening of the Dark Portal (BC Classic)

records.name: Hero of the Brood
records.objectives_text: Return to the child, Andormu, at the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris desert.

prerequisites.wiki_text: The Opening of the Dark Portal

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge B'naar
records.objectives_text: Return to Manaforge B'naar and obtain the B'naar Access Crystal from Overseer Theredis. Use it at the Manaforge B'naar console to shut it down and report back to Anchorite Karja.< Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Unlocking the Compendium
records.objectives_text: Obtain the Heliotrope Oculus from Spellreaver Marathelle at Sunfury Hold. Use Archmage Vargoth's Staff to contact the archmage once you have achieved your goal. If you lose Archmage Vargoth's Staff, speak to Ravandwyr at Area 52 to receive a replacement.

records.name: Volatile Mutations
records.objectives_text: Kill 8 Volatile Mutations, then return to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

records.name: The Blood Elves
records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Blood Elf Scouts then return to Tolaan in the Shadow Ridge of Ammen Vale.

records.name: Vindicator Aldar
records.objectives_text: Speak with Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

records.name: Abjurist Belmara
records.objectives_text: Locate Abjurist Belmara's quarters in Wizard Row and return the book to its Bookshelf. Then, speak with Custodian Dieworth at Kirin'Var Village.

records.name: Conjurer Luminrath
records.objectives_text: Locate Conjurer Luminrath's quarters in Wizard Row and return the mantle to his Dresser. Then, speak with Custodian Dieworth at Kirin'Var Village.

records.name: Cohlien Frostweaver
records.objectives_text: Locate Cohlien Frostweaver's quarters in Wizard Row and return the hat to his Footlocker. Then, speak with Custodian Dieworth at Kirin'Var Village.

records.name: It's a Fel Reaver, But with Heart
records.objectives_text: Recover the Heart of the Fel Reaver and deliver it to N. D. Meancamp at The Heap in the Netherstorm.

wiki.page: It's a Fel Reaver, But with Heart

records.name: Sabotage the Warp-Gate!
records.objectives_text: Escort Drijya to the warp-gate at Invasion Point: Destroyer, and see to it that he is kept safe while he attempts to sabotage it. Then speak to Gahruj at the Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Drijya Needs Your Help
records.objectives_text: Speak with Drijya near Invasion Point: Destroyer in the Netherstorm.

records.name: The Annals of Kirin'Var
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Annals of Kirin'Var from the town hall of Kirin'Var Village and return it to Custodian Dieworth.

records.name: Measuring Warp Energies
records.objectives_text: Exarch Orelis in Area 52 wants you to take the Warp-Attuned Orb to Manaforge B'naar and use it at the end of its four pipelines. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: A Lingering Suspicion
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Loathsome Remnants from the twisted spirits in Kirin'Var Village's Chapel Yard and bring them to Custodian Dieworth.

records.name: Neutralizing the Nethermancers
records.objectives_text: Kill 15 Sunfury Nethermancers and return to Nether-Stalker Oazul at Tuluman's Landing in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Searching for Evidence
records.objectives_text: Search Kirin'Var Village's Chapel Yard for clues about who is behind the manipulation of the spirits.

records.name: Dealing with the Foreman
records.objectives_text: Deal with Foreman Sundown inside the Trelleum Mine, which is underneath Manaforge Ara in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Dealing with the Overmaster
records.objectives_text: Slay Overmaster Grindgarr. Then return to Wind Trader Tuluman at Tuluman's Landing in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Capturing the Phylactery
records.objectives_text: Recover Naberius's Phylactery from Kirin'Var Village's Chapel Yard district and bring it to Custodian Dieworth.

records.name: Destroy Naberius!
records.objectives_text: Custodian Dieworth in Kirin'Var Village wants you to confront and defeat Naberius in the village's Chapel Yard.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge Coruu
records.objectives_text: Travel to Manaforge Coruu, east of Area 52, and obtain the Coruu Access Crystal from Overseer Seylanna. Use it at the Manaforge Coruu Console to shut it down and return to Anchorite Karja. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge Duro
records.objectives_text: Anchorite Karja wants you to go Manaforge Duro and obtain the Duro Access Crystal from Overseer Athanel. Use it at the Manaforge Duro Console to shut it down. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge Ara
records.objectives_text: Travel to Manaforge Ara and obtain the Ara Access Crystal from Overseer Azarad. Use it at the Manaforge Ara console to shut it down. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: The Great Moongraze Hunt
records.objectives_text: Bring 6 Moongraze Buck Hides to Acteon at Azure Watch.

records.name: Marks of Kil'jaeden
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Marks of Kil'jaeden to Adyen the Lightwarden in Shattrath City. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Sunfury Briefings
records.objectives_text: Go to Manaforge Duro and retrieve the Sunfury Military Briefing and the Sunfury Arcane Briefing from the Sunfury units stationed there. Return to Exarch Orellis when you've completed this task. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge B'naar
records.objectives_text: Return to Manaforge B'naar and obtain the B'naar Access Crystal from Overseer Theredis. Use it at the B'naar Control Console to shut it down, then report back to Spymaster Thalodien. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge Coruu
records.objectives_text: Obtain the Coruu Access Crystal from Overseer Seylanna. Use it at the Coruu Control Console to shut down the manaforge and return to Caledis Brightdawn. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Indispensable Tools
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Smithing Hammer from the Kirin'Var Apprentices and bring it back to Apprentice Andrethan in Kirin'Var Village.

records.name: Master Smith Rhonsus
records.objectives_text: Apprentice Andrethan in Kirin'Var Village wants you to kill the ghost of Rhonsus, the town's master blacksmith.

records.name: Help Mama Wheeler
records.objectives_text: Speak with Mama Wheeler at the Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm in the Netherstorm.

records.name: Needs More Cowbell
records.objectives_text: Find Bessy in the fields near Kirin'Var Village's Chapel Hill.

records.name: Surveying the Ruins
records.objectives_text: Place the three Surveying Markers and then return to Zephyrion at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.

records.name: The Minions of Culuthas
records.objectives_text: Slay 10 Hounds of Culuthas and 5 Eyes of Culuthas. Then return to Nether-Stalker Nauthis at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.

records.name: When the Cows Come Home
records.objectives_text: Escort Bessy safely back to her owner, Thadell.

objectives.text: Escort Bessy on her way home.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge Duro
records.objectives_text: Return to Manaforge Duro and obtain the Duro Access Crystal from Overseer Athanel. Use it at the Duro Control Console to shut it down and report back to Spymaster Thalodien. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Shatter Point
records.objectives_text: Forward Commander Kingston wants you to speak with Wing Commander Dabir'ee, ride a gryphon to Shatter Point, and then report to Runetog Wildhammer.

records.name: Kick Them While They're Down
records.objectives_text: Slay 8 Sunfury Conjurers, 6 Sunfury Bowmen and 4 Sunfury Centurions. Return to Magistrix Larynna at Area 52 after completing this task. Completing tasks for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation to decrease.

records.name: Securing the Shaleskin Shale
records.objectives_text: Collect 5 Shaleskin Shale and give them to Boots at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

records.name: The Unending Invasion
records.objectives_text: Search the mana creature infested area of Kirin'Var Village for a Mana Bomb Fragment and bring it to Lieutenant-Sorcerer Morran.

records.name: Wing Commander Gryphongar
records.objectives_text: Speak with Wing Commander Gryphongar in Shatter Point.

records.name: The Flesh Lies...
records.objectives_text: Use the Protectorate Igniter on 12 Withered Corpses. Return the Protectorate Igniter to Agent Araxes outside of Access Shaft Zeon when the task is complete.

records.name: New Opportunities
records.objectives_text: Gather 15 Ivory Bells and return to Mehrdad at Midrealm Post.

records.name: The Earthbinder
records.objectives_text: Take the Crimson Crystal Shard to Earthbinder Galandria Nightbreeze at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Behomat
records.objectives_text: Speak with Behomat at the Traders Tier of the Exodar.

records.name: Natural Remedies
records.objectives_text: Use the Seed of Revitalization at the Earthbinder's Circle to heal the land around the crystal. Then, return to Earthbinder Galandria Nightbreeze at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula with any information that you gain.

records.name: Arconus the Insatiable
records.objectives_text: Agent Ya-six at Access Shaft Zeon in Netherstorm has asked you to slay Arconus the Insatiable and return to Commander Ameer at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm.

records.name: Withered Flesh
records.objectives_text: Gather 5 Parched Hydra Samples and 5 Withered Bog Lord Samples and bring them to Ruam at Telredor.

records.name: Shutting Down Manaforge Ara
records.objectives_text: Travel to Manaforge Ara and obtain the Ara Access Crystal from Overseer Azarad. Use it at the Manaforge Ara console to shut it down. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Jol
records.objectives_text: Speak with Jol in the Vindicators' Sanctum of the Exodar.

records.name: A Traitor Among Us
records.objectives_text: Naladu at the Ruins of Sha'naar wants you to obtain the Sha'naar Key from a nearby hut.

records.name: The Dreghood Elders
records.objectives_text: Free Morod the Windstirrer, Akoru the Firecaller and Aylaan the Waterwaker at the Ruins of Sha'naar. Return to Naladu after completing this task.

records.name: Arzeth's Demise
records.objectives_text: Use the Staff of Dreghood Elders on Arzeth the Merciless and slay him after he's lost his powers. Return to Naladu at the Ruins of Sha'naar after completing this task.

records.name: A Discreet Inquiry
records.objectives_text: Speak with Eralan in Tranquillien.

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Alliance)

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
records.objectives_text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Horde)

records.name: A Dark Pact
records.objectives_text: Kaylaan at Tuluman's Landing in Netherstorm wants you to slay 6 Gan'arg Warp-Tinkers, 3 Daughters of Destiny and 3 Mo'arg Warp-Masters. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Aldor No More
records.objectives_text: Report back to Exarch Orelis at Area 52.

records.name: Go to the Front
records.objectives_text: Take a gryphon to Honor Point and speak with Field Marshal Brock.

records.name: Ethereum Data
records.objectives_text: Recover the Ethereum Data Cell and return it to Commander Ameer.

records.name: Potential for Brain Damage = High
records.objectives_text: Recover 15 pieces of Ethereum Relay Data.

records.name: Return to Thrallmar
records.objectives_text: Return to Thrallmar and speak with Nazgrel.

records.name: The Agony and the Darkness
records.objectives_text: Magister Bloodhawk wants you to kill 10 Terrorfiends in the Pools of Aggonar.

records.name: Forge Camp: Mageddon
records.objectives_text: Nazgrel in Thrallmar wants you to attack Forge Camp: Mageddon and kill 10 Gan'arg Servants and return with the head of Razorsaw.

records.name: Cannons of Rage
records.objectives_text: Destroy 3 Fel Cannon Mk1s in Forge Camp: Rage and return to Nazgrel in Thrallmar.

records.name: Doorway to the Abyss
records.objectives_text: Slay Arix'Amal to get the Burning Legion Gate Key. Use the Burning Legion Gate Key on the Rune of Spite, then return to Nazgrel in Thrallmar.

records.name: Vile Plans
records.objectives_text: Take the Burning Legion Missive to Magister Bloodhawk in Thrallmar.

records.name: Disruption - Forge Camp: Mageddon
records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Gan'arg Servants and Razorsaw at Forge Camp Mageddon and return to Forward Commander Brock at Honor Point.

records.name: The Dark Missive
records.objectives_text: Take the Missive to Warp-Scryer Kryv in the main keep of Honor Hold.

records.name: Enemy of my Enemy...
records.objectives_text: Destroy 3 Fel Cannon MKIs in Forge Camp: Rage and return to Field Marshal Brock at Honor Point.

records.name: Invasion Point: Annihilator
records.objectives_text: Slay Arix'Amal. Take the Burning Legion Gate Key. Use the Burning Legion Gate Key on the Rune of Spite.

records.name: The Heart of Darkness
records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Terrorfiends in the Pools of Aggonar and return to Warp-Scryer Kryv in the main keep of Honor Hold.

records.name: Overlord
records.objectives_text: Slay Arazzius the Cruel in the Pools of Aggonar and return to Force Commander Danath Trollbane in the keep of Honor Hold.

records.name: Naladu
records.objectives_text: Seek out Naladu inside the Ruins of Sha'naar.

records.name: S-A-B-O-T-A-G-E
records.objectives_text: The Image of Commander Ameer at the Ethereum Staging Grounds - Ethereum Transponder Zeta - wants you to recover one Prepared Ethereum Wrapping.

records.name: Delivering the Message
records.objectives_text: Escort the Protectorate Demolitionist to the Manaforge Ultris Conduit and protect him while he sabotages the pipeline.

objectives.text: Speak to the Image of Commander Ameer by using the Ethereum Transponder Zeta at the Ethereum Staging Grounds in Netherstorm.

records.name: Socrethar's Shadow
records.objectives_text: Anchorite Karja at Area 52 wants you to obtain the First Half of Socrethar's Stone from Forgemaster Morug at Forge Base: Oblivion and the Second Half of Socrethar's Stone from Silroth at Forge Base: Gehenna. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
records.objectives_text: Use the Protectorate Disruptor to bring down Salhadaar's force fields, then destroy Nexus-King Salhadaar.

records.name: Deathblow to the Legion
records.objectives_text: High Priestess Ishanah wants you to go to the Legion Teleporter at the northwestern corner of Netherstorm and use it to teleport to Socrethar's Seat. Once there, defeat Socrethar. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: Ishanah's Help
records.objectives_text: Take Socrethar's Teleportation Stone to High Priestess Ishanah at the Shrine of Unending Light on the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: Electro-Shock Goodness!
records.objectives_text: Researcher Navuud at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm has asked that you destroy 30 Void Waste Globules and 30 Seeping Sludge Globules.

records.name: Firewing Signets
records.objectives_text: Magistrix Fyalenn in Shattrath City wants you to bring her 10 Firewing Signets. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: The Horrors of Pollution
records.objectives_text: Take the Vial of Void Horror Ooze to Researcher Navuud at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm.

records.name: Synthesis of Power
records.objectives_text: Voren'thal the Seer in Shattrath City wants you to obtain an Arcane Tome. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation to decrease.

records.name: Run a Diagnostic!
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Diagnostic Results and return them to Mehrdad at Midrealm Post.

records.name: Deal With the Saboteurs
records.objectives_text: Mehrdad at Midrealm Post wants you to kill 8 Barbscale Crocolisks.

records.name: A Cleansing Light
records.objectives_text: Bring a Fel Armament to Ishanah in Shattrath City. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation to decrease.

records.name: Captain Tyralius
records.objectives_text: Flesh Handler Viridius at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm has asked that you find and free Captain Tyralius.

records.name: To the Stormspire
records.objectives_text: Speak with Ghabar at the Stormspire.

records.name: Diagnosis: Critical
records.objectives_text: Use the Diagnostic Device while standing near the Eco-Dome Sutheron Generator and bring the Diagnostic Results back to Ghabar at the Stormspire.

records.name: Flora of the Eco-Domes
records.objectives_text: Use the Energy Field Modulator on Farahlon Lashers. Observe the results and report back to Aurine Moonblaze at the Stormspire when you have conducted 10 tests.

records.name: Creatures of the Eco-Domes
records.objectives_text: Tag 12 Talbuks for Aurine Moonblaze at the Stormspire. You may tag either Talbuk Sires or Talbuk Does using the Talbuk Tagger.

records.name: The Missing Fisherman
records.objectives_text: Find Cowlen at the southeast docks of Silvermyst Isle off the coast of Azuremyst.

records.name: When Nature Goes Too Far
records.objectives_text: Aurine Moonblaze at the Stormspire wants you to bring her a Hulking Hydra Heart.

records.name: Testing the Prototype
records.objectives_text: Bring the Repair Apparatus to Tashar at Eco-Dome Farfield.

records.name: Outside Assistance
records.objectives_text: Go to Tuluman's Landing, north of Area 52, and speak to Kaylaan. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Damning Evidence
records.objectives_text: Obtain 8 Orders from Kael'thas from demons at Manaforge Ara and bring them to Spymaster Thalodien in Area 52. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation to decrease.

records.name: Keeping Up Appearances
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Ripfang Lynx Pelts to Shauly Pore at Midrealm Post.

records.name: The Dynamic Duo
records.objectives_text: Speak with Audi the Needle at the Stormspire.

records.name: Retrieving the Goods
records.objectives_text: Audi the Needle at the Stormspire wants you to bring her 10 Dome Generator Segments.

records.name: All Clear!
records.objectives_text: Tashar, stationed at Eco-Dome Farfield, wants you to kill 12 Scythetooth Raptors.

records.name: Recipe for Destruction
records.objectives_text: Recover 4 Fragments of Dimensius.

records.name: On Nethery Wings
records.objectives_text: Professor Dabiri at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm wants you to use your Phase Disruptor when you get in range of the Void Conduit that rests atop Ultris. Drop as many charges of the Phase Disruptor as you can to ensure total annihilation. records.objectives_text: Speak with Captain Saeed, follow his army to Manaforge Ultris, and kill Dimensius the All-Devouring!

records.name: Success!
records.objectives_text: Return to the Stormspire and speak with Ghabar.

records.name: The Final Code
records.objectives_text: Lieutenant Meridian wants you to use The Final Code to set off the Mana Bomb. Then report back to Jenai Starwhisper at the Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.

records.name: Escape from Coilskar Cistern
records.objectives_text: Escort Earthmender Wilda out of Coilskar Cistern and then seek out Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation, found at the western outskirts of the Hand of Gul'dan.

records.name: The Encroaching Wilderness
records.objectives_text: Rina Moonspring wishes you to slay 12 Grovestalker Lynxes with all due haste and then return to her at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.objectives_text: Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to use the Totem of Spirits to capture 5 Watery Souls.

records.objectives_text: Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to use the Totem of Spirits to capture 10 Airy Souls.

records.objectives_text: Kill 20 Bonechewer Orcs and return to Amadi in Honor Hold.

records.objectives_text: Bring Warlord Morkh's Shattered Armor to Corporal Ironridge in Expedition Point.

records.name: Dust from the Drakes
records.objectives_text: Gor'drek wants you to gather 4 Dusts of the Fey Drake. After doing so, return to him at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Protecting Our Own
records.objectives_text: Use Gor'drek's Ointment on 5 of the Thunderlord Dire Wolves to strengthen them and the defense of the Jagged Ridge. Then return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Felling an Ancient Tree
records.objectives_text: Acquire Stronglimb Deeproot's Trunk and deliver it to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.objectives_text: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dungeon Set 1 Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.

records.objectives_text: Commander Skyshadow has tasked you with the destruction of any 30 Bloodmaul Ogres at Bloodmaul Outpost. Return to him at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains once your gruesome task is completed.

records.name: The Bladespire Threat
records.objectives_text: Tor'chunk Twoclaws has tasked you with the destruction of any 30 Bladespire Ogres and 10 Bladespire Raptors at Bladespire Hold and the Bladespire Grounds. Return to him at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains once your task is completed.

records.name: The Bladespire Ogres
records.objectives_text: You have been asked by Commander Skyshadow to kill any 30 Bladespire Ogres in Bladespire Hold and the Bladespire Grounds. Return to him at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains once you have done so.

records.name: The Bloodmaul Ogres
records.objectives_text: You have been asked by Tor'chunk Twoclaws to kill any 30 Bloodmaul Ogres at Bloodmaul Outpost. Return to him at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains once you have done so.

records.name: A Dire Situation
records.objectives_text: Rina Moonspring wants you to take her Diminution Powder and apply it to 5 of the Bloodmaul Dire Wolves, which can be found at Bloodmaul Outpost and in Bloodmaul Ravine. After doing so, return to her at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Turning Point
records.objectives_text: Use Socrethar's Teleportation's Stone at Invasion Point: Overlord, north of Forge Base: Oblivion to transport your party to Socrethar's Landing. Once there, use Voren'thal's Presence to defeat Socrethar. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation to decrease.

records.name: A Gift for Voren'thal
records.objectives_text: Spymaster Thalodien at Area 52 wants you to obtain the First Half of Socrethar's Stone from Forgemaster Morug at Forge Base: Oblivion and the Second Half of Socrethar's Stone from Silroth at Forge Base: Gehenna. Completing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation to decrease.

records.name: Bound for Glory
records.objectives_text: Bring Socrethar's Teleportation Stone to Voren'thal the Seer at the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City. Completing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation to decrease.

records.name: Into the Draenethyst Mine
records.objectives_text: Bronwyn Stouthammer has asked you to collect 5 Draenethyst Mine Crystals and then return to her at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Strange Brew
records.objectives_text: Borgrim Stouthammer wants you to procure 11 Bloodmaul Brutebane Brew for him. Once you've done that, return it to him at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Getting the Bladespire Tanked
records.objectives_text: Take the Bloodmaul Brutebane Keg and use it in an attempt to get 5 Bladespire Ogres drunk. If you're successful, return to Borgrim at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Oronok Torn-heart
records.objectives_text: Seek out Oronok Torn-heart on the Shattered Shelf - north of Coilskar Cistern.

records.name: I Was A Lot Of Things...
records.objectives_text: Oronok Torn-heart at Oronok's Farm in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to recover 10 Shadowmoon Tubers from the Shattered Plains. He also wants Oronok's Boar Whistle back when you're done.

wiki.page: I Was A Lot Of Things...

records.name: A Lesson Learned
records.objectives_text: Oronok Torn-heart at Oronok's Farm in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to destroy 10 Ravenous Flayer Eggs on the Shattered Plains.

records.name: The Trappings of a Vindicator
records.objectives_text: Retrieve Vindicator Vuuleen's Blade and Vindicator Vuuleen's Shield. Then return them to Vindicator Vuuleen at Bladespire Hold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Gorr'Dim, Your Time Has Come...
records.objectives_text: Vindicator Vuuleen has asked you to kill Gorr'Dim, leader of the Bladespire Hold ogres. Once you have done so, return to her at Bladespire Hold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Planting the Banner
records.objectives_text: Use the Bladespire Banner atop the Northmaul Tower to lure Gurn Grubnosh. Deliver the banner and the Helm of Gurn Grubnosh to Commander Skyshadow at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Cipher of Damnation - Truth and History
records.objectives_text: Oronok Torn-heart at Oronok's Farm in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to listen to his story. Speak to Oronok to begin hearing his story.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Thunderlord Clan Drum, Thunderlord Clan Arrow and the Thunderlord Clan Tablet. Return them, along with the Thunderlord Clan Artifact, to Rokgah Bloodgrip at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.objectives_text: Use the Fiery Soul Fragment to transform your spirit into a vision guide. Speak with Rokgah Bloodgrip at Thunderlord Stronghold after your vision has guided you to the location of the final Thunderlord relic.

records.objectives_text: Seek out and slay Painmistress Gabrissa at Illidari Point and return to the corpse of Ar'tor, Son of Oronok with the Crystalline Key.

records.objectives_text: Retrieve T'chali's Hookah and 10 Bloodmaul Brutebane Brews. Bring them back to T'chali the Witch Doctor at Bloodmaul Ravine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Grimnok and Korgaah, I Am For You!
records.objectives_text: T'chali the Witch Doctor has asked you to kill his chief tormentors, Grimnok Battleborn and Korgaah. After you have done so, return to him at Bloodmaul Ravine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

wiki.page: Grimnok and Korgaah, I Am For You!

records.name: A Curse Upon Both of Your Clans!
records.objectives_text: Use the Wicked Strong Fetish to curse 5 buildings or towers in Bladespire Hold and 2 in Bloodmaul Outpost. Return to T'chali the Witch Doctor at Bloodmaul Ravine in the Blade's Edge Mountains after you have done so.

wiki.page: A Curse Upon Both of Your Clans!

records.name: Bladespire Kegger
records.objectives_text: T'chali has asked you to take the Bloodmaul Brutebane Keg and use it in an attempt to get 5 Bladespire Ogres drunk. If successful, return to T'chali the Witch Doctor at Bloodmaul Ravine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Borak, Son of Oronok
records.objectives_text: Find Borak hiding near Eclipse Point, far to the south. He watches from the shadows of the bridge.

records.name: Of Thistleheads and Eggs...
records.objectives_text: Find a Rotten Arakkoa Egg and deliver it to Tobias the Filth Gorger in Shattrath City.

records.name: The Sad Truth

records.name: The Bundle of Bloodthistle
records.objectives_text: Take the Bundle of Bloodthistle back to Borak, Son of Oronok at the bridge near Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley.

records.name: Voren'thal the Seer
records.objectives_text: Speak to Voren'thal the Seer inside the Seer's Library at the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Ishanah
records.objectives_text: Speak to Ishanah inside the Shrine of Unending Light at the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Malaise
records.objectives_text: Collect 18 Plucked Lashh'an Feathers, then read the Lashh'an Tome in the treetops of Veil Lashh.

records.name: Scratches
records.objectives_text: Use the Fistful of Feathers on the Lashh'an Spell Circle, then return to Daranelle at Sylvanaar before the kaliri spirit fades.

records.name: Test Flight: The Zephyrium Capacitorium
records.objectives_text: Speak with Rally Zapnabber and use the Zephyrium Capacitorium. Return to Tally Zapnabber at Toshley's Station.

records.name: Besieged!
records.objectives_text: Wing Commander Nuainn, outside of Wildhammer Stronghold, wants you to kill 10 Infernal Attackers.

records.name: To Legion Hold
records.objectives_text: Make your way to Legion Hold and locate the Legion Communication Device. While standing near the communication device, use your disguise and learn about the Legion's plans. Return to Wing Commander Nuainn at Wildhammer Stronghold when you've completed your mission.

records.name: Blast the Infernals!
records.objectives_text: Use the Fel Bomb while standing on the green glyph in Legion Hold, then report to Wing Commander Nuainn at Wildhammer Stronghold.

records.name: The Stones of Vekh'nir
records.objectives_text: Collect and use a Vekh'nir Crystal at the Vekh'nir Spell Circle, then return the Charged Vekh'nir Crystal to Dertrok at the Mok'Nathal Village.

records.name: Trial and Error
records.objectives_text: Try out each of Dertrok's wands on an Arakkoa Ogre Slave, then return to Dertrok. Each wand will require an Infused Vekh'nir Crystal to use.

records.name: Creating the Pendant
records.objectives_text: Find 6 Ruuan'ok Claws and use them at the Ruuan'ok Oracle Circle to summon a Harbinger of the Raven. Kill it and return its Harbinger's Pendant to Timeon at Ruuan Weald.

records.name: Tablets of Baa'ri
records.objectives_text: Anchorite Ceyla at the Altar of Sha'tar wants you to collect 12 Baa'ri Tablets from the ground and from Ashtongue Workers at the Ruins of Baa'ri. Completing quests with the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: The Sketh'lon Wreckage
records.objectives_text: Recover the Skethlon Commander's Journal Page 1, Skethlon Commander's Journal Page 2, and Skethlon Commander's Journal Page 3 from the Dark Conclave arakkoa at the Sketh'lon Wreckage to Gryphonrider Kieran.

records.name: To Catch A Thistlehead
records.objectives_text: Borak, Son of Oronok at the bridge near Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to recover the Stormrage Missive.

records.name: Oronu the Elder
records.objectives_text: Anchorite Ceyla at the Altar of Sha'tar wants you to obtain the Orders from Akama from Oronu the Elder at the Ruins of Baa'ri. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Setting Up the Bomb
records.objectives_text: Obtain a Fel Reaver Power Core and a Fel Reaver Armor Plate and bring them to Wing Commander Nuainn at Wildhammer Stronghold.

records.name: The Deathforge
records.objectives_text: Report to Stormer Ewan Wildwing at the Deathforge Tower.

records.name: The Ashtongue Corruptors
records.objectives_text: Obtain the four medallion fragments from Haalum, Eykenen, Lakaan and Uylaru and return to Anchorite Ceyla at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley. Performing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: The Warden's Cage

records.name: A Boaring Time for Grulloc

records.name: Meeting at the Blackwing Coven
records.objectives_text: Gather up enough Costume Scraps from the various wyrmcultists to create an Overseer Disguise. Use the disguise to attend the meeting with Kolphis Darkscale, and report your findings back to Tree Warden Chawn at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater
records.objectives_text: Go to Boulder'mok and collect 3 Grisly Totems from the Boulder'mok ogres. Use Sablemane's Trap at Gorgrom's Altar to set the trap and summon and kill Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater. When Gorgrom is dead, place the 3 Grisly Totems near his corpse, then return to Rexxar at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Prisoner of the Bladespire
records.objectives_text: Kill Bladespire ogres to get the Wyvern Cage Key. Once you have it, go to the Wyvern Cage and use Spirit's Whistle to summon Spirit, who will unlock the cage. After Leokk is free, return to Rexxar at Thunderlord Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.objectives_text: Use Rexxar's Battle Horn at the Altar of Goc, then kill Goc. Return to Rexxar at Thunderlord Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains when this is done.

records.name: News of Victory
records.objectives_text: Return to Shadowmoon Village and speak with Overlord Or'barokh.

records.name: Whelps of the Wyrmcult
records.objectives_text: Samia Inkling has asked you to use the Blackwhelp Net to capture 10 Wyrmcult Blackwhelps. Return them to her at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Maxnar Must Die!
records.objectives_text: On behalf of the Cenarion Expedition druids of Evergrove, and the indigenous life of the Ruuan Weald, Tree Warden Chawn has asked you to slay Maxnar the Ashmaw. Return to him at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains after you have done so.

records.name: Baron Sablemane's Poison
records.objectives_text: Deliver Baron Sablemane's Poison to Rexxar at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Path of Conquest
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Path of Conquest in Shadowmoon Valley. Once you have done a preliminary assessment of the area, use the Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal a Kor'kron Wind Rider. Speak with Overlord Or'barokh should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

records.name: Breaching the Path
records.objectives_text: Slay 20 Eclipsion Soldiers, 10 Eclipsion Cavaliers, and 10 Eclipsion Spellbinders and then use the :Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal another Kor'kron Wind Rider to report your task complete. Speak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

records.name: Onward to Ashenvale
records.objectives_text: Speak with Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

records.name: Culling the Wild
records.objectives_text: Kill 4 Felsworn Scalewing, 4 Felsworn Daggermaw, and 2 Fel Corrupters.

records.name: Entry Into the Citadel
records.objectives_text: Bring the Primed Key Mold to Force Commander Danath at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Entry Into the Citadel
records.objectives_text: Bring the Primed Key Mold to Nazgrel at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Grand Master Rohok
records.objectives_text: Bring the Primed Key Mold to Rohok at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Rohok's Request
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Fel Iron Bars, 2 Arcane Dust and 4 Motes of Fire to Rohok at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Hotter than Hell
records.objectives_text: Destroy a Fel Reaver in Hellfire Peninsula and plunge the Unfired Key Mold into its remains. Bring the Charred Key Mold to Rohok in Thrallmar.

records.name: Find the Deserter
records.objectives_text: Locate Parshah in the Magma Fields and speak to him.

records.name: The Sketh'lon Wreckage
records.objectives_text: Recover the Skethlon Commander's Journal Page 1, Skethlon Commander's Journal Page 2, and Skethlon Commander's Journal Page 3 from the Dark Conclave arakkoa at the Sketh'lon Wreckage to Sergeant Kargrul at Shadowmoon Village.

records.name: Find the Deserter
records.objectives_text: Locate Parshah in the Magma Fields and speak to him.

records.name: Dumphry's Request
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Fel Iron Bars, 2 Arcane Dust and 4 Motes of Fire to Dumphry at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Hotter than Hell
records.objectives_text: Destroy a Fel Reaver in Hellfire Peninsula and plunge the Unfired Key Mold into its remains. Bring the Charred Key Mold to Dumphry in Honor Hold.

records.name: When Worlds Collide...
records.objectives_text: Slay Chancellor Bloodleaf and Corok the Mighty and recover Illidan's Command. Use the Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal another Kor'kron Wind Rider once you have accomplished this task. Speak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

records.objectives_text: Report to Plexi at Invasion Point: Cataclysm.

records.name: Invasion Point: Cataclysm
records.objectives_text: Report to Nakansi at Invasion Point: Cataclysm.

records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Illidari Tabards and then use the :Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal another Kor'kron Wind Rider. Speak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

records.name: Dissension Amongst the Ranks...
records.objectives_text: Slay 5 Crazed Colossus while in disguise as an Illidari blood elf and return to Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley. He will also want his Kor'kron Flare Gun returned.

records.objectives_text: Mosswood the Ancient wants you to journey to Skald and plant Ironroot Seeds in three different mounds of Fertile Volcanic Soil and then return to him in Ruuan Weald.

records.name: Asghar's Totem
records.objectives_text: Bring the Sketh'lon War Totem to Parshah in the Magma Fields.

records.name: The Rod of Lianthe
records.objectives_text: Obtain Lianthe's Key from any of the blood elves at Eclipse Point and use it to open Lianthe's Strongbox and claim the Rod of Lianthe. Return the rod to Parshah in the Magma Fields.

records.name: Sketh'lon Feathers
records.objectives_text: Gather 8 Sketh'lon Feathers and bring them to Parshah in the Magma Fields.

records.name: Battle of the Crimson Watch
records.objectives_text: Battle the forces of Illidan at Crimson Watch and survive! Return to A'dal at Shattrath City should you emerge the victor.

records.name: Imbuing the Headpiece
records.objectives_text: Equip the Unfinished Headpiece, travel to the Altar of Damnation, and use it while standing near Gul'dan. When the headpiece is energized, return to Parshah in the Magma Fields.

records.name: Baron Sablemane
records.objectives_text: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Crush the Bloodmaul Camp
records.objectives_text: Tor'chunk Twoclaws has asked you to slay 10 Bloodmaul Maulers and 5 Bloodmaul Warlocks. Afterward, return to him at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: It's a Trap!
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Dragonfire Trap to Rexxar at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Slaughter at Boulder'mok
records.objectives_text: Slaughter 5 Boulder'mok Brutes and 3 Boulder'mok Shaman, and then return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Return to Talionia
records.objectives_text: Speak with Talionia in Silvermoon City.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Carendin Halgar in Undercity.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

objectives.text: Help Malukaz Summon the Wolf Spirit

records.name: Zeth'Gor Must Burn!
records.objectives_text: Kill Bleeding Hollow Peons for their torches, ignite them at Zeth'Gor's forge then throw the burning torches at Zeth'Gor Buildings.

records.name: The Journal of Val'zareq: Portends of War
records.objectives_text: Locate Marcus Auralion, High General of the Sha'tar, at Crimson Watch. Look for him inside a crystalline prison.

wiki.page: The Journal of Val'zareq: Portends of War

records.name: Rogues of the Shattered Hand
records.objectives_text: Speak with Shenthul in Orgrimmar.

records.name: A Date with Dorgok
records.objectives_text: Commander Haephus Stonewall has asked you to kill Dorgok at Bloodmaul Camp. Return to him at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains after you have done the deed.

records.name: Crush the Bloodmaul Camp!
records.objectives_text: Lieutenant Fairweather has tasked you with slaying 10 Bloodmaul Maulers and 5 Bloodmaul Warlocks. Afterward, return to her at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Favor of the Gronn
records.objectives_text: Deliver Gorgrom's Favor to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Pay the Baron a Visit
records.objectives_text: Speak with Baron Sablemane about fashioning a trap. He is located at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Into the Churning Gulch
records.objectives_text: Baron Sablemane has told you to bring him 7 Crust Burster Venom Glands. Return to him at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains once you have procured them.

records.name: Goodnight, Gronn
records.objectives_text: Baron Sablemane wants you to steal Grulloc's Sack, and then return it to him at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: It's a Trap!
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Dragonfire Trap to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater
records.objectives_text: Go to Boulder'mok and collect 3 Grisly Totems from the Boulder'mok ogres. Use Sablemane's Trap at Gorgrom's Altar to summon and kill Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater. When Gorgrom is dead, place the 3 Grisly Totems near his corpse, then return to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Slaughter at Boulder'mok
records.objectives_text: Slaughter 5 Boulder'mok Brutes and 3 Boulder'mok Shaman, and then return to Lieutenant Fairweather at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Kindness
records.objectives_text: Mordenai at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to feed 8 Mature Netherwing Drakes.

records.name: Massacre at Gruul's Lair
records.objectives_text: Baron Sablemane has tasked you and your friends with the deaths of 10 Bladespire Enforcers, 5 Bladespire Battlemages, 5 Bladespire Ravagers and their leader, Fingrom. When you have managed this feat, return to him at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Showdown
records.objectives_text: Use Sablemane's Signet at the Altar of Goc, then kill Goc. Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains when this is done.

records.name: The Ashtongue Broken
records.objectives_text: Varen the Reclaimer wants you to go to the Ruins of Baa'ri and slay 3 Ashtongue Handlers, 4 Ashtongue Warriors and 6 Ashtongue Shaman. Completing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Thwart the Dark Conclave
records.objectives_text: Slay the Dark Conclave Ritualists and use the Staff of Parshah to end the Dark Conclave's summoning ritual, then return to Parshah in the Magma Fields.

records.name: WANTED: Worg Master Kruush
records.objectives_text: Kill Worg Master Kruush and bring his head to Captain Darkhowl in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: Damaged Mask
records.objectives_text: Bring the Damaged Mask to O'Mally Zapnabber in Ruuan Weald.

records.name: Seek Out Neltharaku
records.objectives_text: Seek out Neltharaku, patron of the Netherwing Dragonflight.

records.name: Mystery Mask
records.objectives_text: Bring the Mystery Mask to Wildlord Antelarion in Ruuan Weald.

records.name: The Eyes of Grillok
records.objectives_text: Use Zezzak's Shard to capture an Eye of Grillok, then approach Zezzak's cauldron to extract it. After it is removed, return Zezzak's Shard to him.

records.name: Neltharaku's Tale
records.objectives_text: Speak with Neltharaku and listen to his story.

records.name: Reclaiming Holy Grounds
records.objectives_text: Vindicator Aluumen wants you to slay 8 Shadowmoon Slayers, 8 Shadowmoon Chosen and 4 Shadowmoon Darkweaver. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: The Great Retribution
records.objectives_text: Varen the Reclaimer wants you to slay 8 Shadowmoon Slayers, 8 Shadowmoon Chosen and 4 Shadowmoon Darkweavers. Completing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Baron Sablemane Has Requested Your Presence
records.objectives_text: You have received an invitation to speak again with Baron Sablemane on some matter of import. Go to him at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

wiki.page: Baron Sablemane Has Requested Your Presence

records.name: Felsworn Gas Mask
records.objectives_text: Wear the Felsworn Gas Mask and use the Legion Communicator at Forge Camp: Anger.

records.name: Deceive thy Enemy
records.objectives_text: Kill 4 Doomforge Attendant's and 4 Doomforge Engineer's.

records.name: You're Fired!
records.objectives_text: Kill Doomcryer and report back to Wildlord Antelarion at Ruuan Weald.

records.name: Sunfury Signets
records.objectives_text: Battlemage Vyara at the Sanctum of the Stars wants you to bring her 10 Sunfury Signets. Performing quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.

records.name: The Truth Unorbed
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Orb of the Grishna to Tree Warden Chawn at Ruuan Weald in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Marks of Sargeras
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Marks of Sargeras to Harbinger Saronen in Shadowmoon Valley. Completing quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.

records.name: Treebole Must Know
records.objectives_text: Tree Warden Chawn has asked you to seek out and speak with Treebole, an ancient of lore who lives in the Raven's Wood of the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Exorcising the Trees
records.objectives_text: Collect 5 Grishnath Orbs and 5 Dire Pinfeathers and then combine them into Exorcism Feathers. Use these feathers to exorcise and slay 5 Koi-Koi Spirits from the Raven's Wood Leafbeards. Once you've done this, return to Treebole in the Raven's Wood of the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Becoming a Mooncloth Tailor
records.objectives_text: Use the :Square of Imbued Netherweave while standing in Cenarion Refuge's moonwell to create a :Sample of Primal Mooncloth. Bring the completed sample back to Nasmara Moonsong in Shattrath's Lower City. *WARNING!* You can only select one tailoring specialization.

records.name: Becoming a Spellfire Tailor
records.objectives_text: Bring a sample of Nether-Wraith Essence to Gidge Spellweaver in Shattrath's Lower City. *WARNING!* You can only select one tailoring specialization.

records.name: Becoming a Shadoweave Tailor
records.objectives_text: Use the Crystal of Deep Shadows near the Altar of Shadows to deepen your attunement to the altar, then return to Andrion Darkspinner in Shattrath's Lower City. *WARNING!* You can only select one tailoring specialization.

records.name: Grillok "Darkeye"
records.objectives_text: Kill Grillok Darkeye and bring Grillok's Eyepatch to Zezzak in Spinebreaker Post.

records.name: Apothecary Antonivich
records.objectives_text: Bring Albreck's Findings to Apothecary Antonivich in Thrallmar.

records.name: Infiltrating Dragonmaw Fortress
records.objectives_text: Neltharaku, flying high above Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley, wants you to slay 15 Dragonmaw Orcs. Any Dragonmaw Orc in Dragonmaw Fortress will suffice.

records.name: To Netherwing Ledge!
records.objectives_text: Neltharaku, flying high above Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley, wants you to collect 12 Nethervine Crystals from Netherwing Ledge.

records.name: The Demoniac Scryer
records.objectives_text: Use the :Demoniac Scryer in Hellfire Basin, wait for it to attune, and then take a reading. Return the Demoniac Scryer and the :Demoniac Scryer Reading to Apothecary Antonivich in Thrallmar.

records.name: Veil Skith: Darkstone of Terokk
records.objectives_text: Use the Rod of Purification on the Darkstone of Terokk in Veil Skith and return to Kirrik at the Refugee Caravan in Bone Wastes.

objectives.text: Attempt to purify the Darkstone of Terokk

records.name: The Tomb of Lights
records.objectives_text: High Priest Orglum wants you to journey to the Tomb of Lights and kill 10 Ethereal Nethermancers and 10 Ethereal Plunderers and then return to him by the Refugee Caravan.

records.name: Since Time Forgotten...
records.objectives_text: In order to prove yourself to the Mok'Nathal, Leoroxx has ordered you to slay Gnosh Brognat, leader of the ogres at the Bladespire Outpost. Return to Leoroxx at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains after you have done so, or do not return at all.

records.name: Slay the Brood Mother
records.objectives_text: Leoroxx has challenged you to slay Dreadwing. Return to him at Mok'Nathal Village once you have managed to kill her.

records.name: Understanding the Mok'Nathal
records.objectives_text: To begin your understanding of the Mok'Nathal, slay Vekh, leader of the Vekh'nir arakkoa. Then, return to Leoroxx at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Eyes of Skettis
records.objectives_text: Bring the Eye of Reskk and the Eye of Shienor to Rilak the Redeemed in the Lower City district of Shattrath.

records.name: Veil Rhaze: Unliving Evil
records.objectives_text: Kill 4 Deathtalon Spirits, 4 Screeching Spirits and 2 Spirit Ravens and return to Kirrik at the Refugee Caravan.

records.name: Seek Out Kirrik
records.objectives_text: Take Rilak's Missive to Kirrik at the Refugee Caravan in the Bone Wastes.

records.name: The Totems of My Enemy
records.objectives_text: Collect 5 Bladespire Totems for Spiritcaller Dohgar at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Missing Friends
records.objectives_text: Ethan wants you to find 12 of his missing friends in Veil Skith and then return to him at the Refugee Caravan.

records.name: Spirit Calling
records.objectives_text: Spiritcaller Dohgar has asked you to use the Spirit Calling Totems to collect 8 Lesser Nether Drake Spirits and return them to him at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Force of Neltharaku
records.objectives_text: Neltharaku, flying high above Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley, wants you to free 5 Enslaved Netherwing Drakes.

records.name: Fel Reavers, No Thanks!
records.objectives_text: Obtain 5 Condensed Nether Gas from Gan'arg Mekgineers at Forge Base: Oblivion, northwest of the Stormspire, and load them into a nearby Inactive Fel Reaver. Return to Nether-Stalker Nauthis after you've completed this task.

records.name: The Best Defense
records.objectives_text: Nether-Stalker Nauthis wants you to slay 12 Wrathbringers at Forge Base: Gehenna, north of the Stormspire.

records.name: Teleport This!
records.objectives_text: Nether-Stalker Nauthis wants you to use the Mental Interference Rod on the Mo'arg at Forge Base: Gehenna and use their Detonate Teleporter ability on the three teleporters in the forge camp.

records.name: Karynaku
records.objectives_text: Seek out Karynaku at Dragonmaw Fortress.

records.name: Gather the Orbs
records.objectives_text: Spiritcaller Dohgar has asked you to use the Orb Collecting Totem to collect 15 Razaani Light Orbs. Return to him at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains after you have done so.

records.name: Mok'Nathal Treats
records.objectives_text: Matron Varah has given you a list of ingredients for the making of her two favorite dishes, which includes the collection of 3 Raptor Ribs and 3 Serpent Flesh. Bring them to her at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Veil Lithic: Preemptive Strike
records.objectives_text: Break the cursed eggs in Veil Lithic. Redeem 3 Hatchlings and slay 3 Malevolent Hatchlings before returning to Kirrik at the Refugee Caravan.

records.name: Surrender to the Horde
records.objectives_text: Rokag wants you to seek out Rilak the Redeemed in Shattrath and demand that he and his people surrender to the Horde.

records.name: Secrets of the Arakkoa
records.objectives_text: Lady Dena Kennedy wants you to seek out Rilak the Redeemed in Shattrath and find out what secrets he will share of the Arakkoa.

records.name: A Burden of Souls
records.objectives_text: Kill 20 Shattered Hand orcs, then return to Apothecary Antonivich in Thrallmar.

records.name: Inform Leoroxx!
records.objectives_text: Spiritcaller Dohgar has implored you to inform Leoroxx about what the Razaani ethereal are up to. He can be found at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Zuluhed the Whacked
records.objectives_text: Kill Zuluhed the Whacked and recover :Zuluhed's Key. Use Zuluhed's Key on Zuluhed's Chains to free Karynaku.

records.name: There Can Be Only One Response
records.objectives_text: Leoroxx has beseeched you to retrieve the Collection of Souls and return them to Spiritcaller Dohgar at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

wiki.page: There Can Be Only One Response

records.name: Arakkoa War Path
records.objectives_text: Advisor Faila asks that you kill 14 Shienor Talonites and 6 Shienor Sorcerers and then return to her in Stonebreaker Hold.

records.name: Thin the Flock
records.objectives_text: Lieutenant Gravelhammer asks that you kill 14 Shienor Talonites and 6 Shienor Sorcerers and then return to him in Allerian Stronghold.

records.name: Ally of the Netherwing
records.objectives_text: Let Karynaku return you to Mordenai in the Netherwing Fields.

records.name: Taken in the Night
records.objectives_text: Scout Navrin wants you to travel to the Netherweb Ridge and free 6 Webbed Sha'tar Warriors and then return to him at Sha'tari Base Camp.

records.name: Veil Shalas: Signal Fires
records.objectives_text: Kirrik at the Refugee Caravan wants you to extinguish the four signal fires of Veil Shalas.

records.name: Report to Nazgrel
records.objectives_text: Speak with Nazgrel in Thrallmar.

records.name: The Foot of the Citadel
records.objectives_text: Kill Force-Commander Gorax, place the Challenge From the Horde upon his corpse, kill The Hand of Kargath, and then bring the Head of the Hand of Kargath to Nazgrel in Thrallmar.

objectives.text: The Head of the Hand of Kargath
