records.name: The Dread Relic
records.objectives_text: Oakun wants you to travel east to the Derelict Caravan to recover the Dread Relic. Return to Oakun when the task is complete.

records.name: Before Darkness Falls
records.objectives_text: Mekeda at the Refugee Caravan in Terokkar Forest wants you to kill 8 Cabal Skirmishers, 4 Cabal Spell-Weavers and 2 Cabal Initiates.

records.name: The Skettis Offensive
records.objectives_text: Hold off the attackers and speak with Rilak.

records.name: Cabal Orders
records.objectives_text: Bring the Cabal Orders to Mekeda at the Refugee Caravan in Terokkar Forest.

records.name: The Shadow Tomb
records.objectives_text: Go into the Shadow Tomb, west of the Refugee Caravan and retrieve the Drape of Arunen, the Gavel of K'alen and the Scroll of Atalor. Return to Mekeda at the Refugee Caravan after you've completed this task.

records.name: Harbinger of Doom
records.objectives_text: You have been tasked to go to Tempest Keep's Arcatraz satellite and slay Harbinger Skyriss. Return to A'dal at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City after you have done so.

records.name: The Tempest Key
records.objectives_text: Speak to A'dal in Shattrath City.

records.name: Trial of the Naaru: Mercy
records.objectives_text: This quest must be completed in Heroic dungeon difficulty.

records.name: Trial of the Naaru: Strength
records.objectives_text: A'dal in Shattrath City wants you to recover Kalithresh's Trident and Murmur's Essence. This quest must be completed in Heroic dungeon difficulty.

records.name: Trial of the Naaru: Tenacity
records.objectives_text: This quest must be completed in Heroic dungeon difficulty.

records.name: Escaping The Tomb
records.objectives_text: Help Akuno find his way to the Refugee Caravan in Terokkar Forest. Speak to Mekeda after you've completed this quest.

records.name: Trial of the Naaru: Magtheridon
records.objectives_text: A'dal in Shattrath City wants you to slay Magtheridon.

records.name: Return to Shattrath
records.objectives_text: Travel to Shattrath City and speak with Rilak.

records.name: Imperial Plate Armor
records.objectives_text: Speak with Derotain Mudsipper in Gadgetzan.

records.name: Imperial Plate Armor
records.objectives_text: Speak with Derotain Mudsipper in Gadgetzan.

records.name: Longtail is the Lynchpin
records.objectives_text: Eliminate Draaca Longtail, the leader of the wyrmcultists in Wyrmskull Tunnel. Report back to Watcher Moonshade at the Wyrmskull Tunnel in the Blade's Edge Mountains once you have done so.

records.name: Wyrmskull Watcher
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Meeting Note to Watcher Moonshade at the entrance of the Wyrmskull Tunnel in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Zeth'Gor Must Burn!
records.objectives_text: Use the smoke beacon at each of Zeth'Gor's towers, and then return to Wing Commander Dabir'ee at Expedition Point.

records.name: The Infested Protectors
records.objectives_text: Lakotae wants you to kill 25 Wood Mites and then return to him at the Refugee Caravan. The mites can be found living inside the bodies of Rotting Forest-Ragers and Infested Root-Walkers.

records.name: Master of Potions
records.objectives_text: Lauranna Thar'well wants you to go to the Botanica in Tempest Keep and retrieve the Botanist's Field Guide from High Botanist Freywinn. In addition she also wants you to bring her 5 Super Healing Potions, 5 Super Mana Potions and 5 Major Dreamless Sleep Potions.

records.name: Skywing
records.objectives_text: Escort Skywing and report to Rilak the Redeemed in Shattrath City.

records.name: Master of Transmutation
records.objectives_text: Zarevhi at the Stormspire in Netherstorm wants you to bring him 4 Primal Mights.

records.name: Master of Elixirs
records.objectives_text: Go to the Black Morass in the Caverns of Time and obtain 10 Essences of Infinity from Rift Lords and Rift Keepers. Bring these along with 5 Elixirs of Major Defense, 5 Elixirs of Mastery and 5 Elixirs of Major Agility to Lorokeem in Shattrath's Lower City.

records.name: Return to Honor Hold
records.objectives_text: Speak with Assistant Klatu, at Honor Hold's inn.

records.name: Harvesting the Fel Ammunition
records.objectives_text: The Evergrove Druid has asked you to collect 5 Fel Cannonballs. Once you have done so, use the Druid Signal to call to the Evergrove Druid inside of Death's Door at the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Master of Potions
records.objectives_text: Speak to Lauranna Thar'well at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh. *WARNING!* You can only select one alchemy specialization.

records.name: Master of Elixirs
records.objectives_text: Speak to Lorokeem in Shattrath's Lower City.

records.name: Master of Transmutation
records.objectives_text: Speak to Zarevhi at the Stormspire in Netherstorm.

records.name: Speak with Rilak the Redeemed
records.objectives_text: Kirrik the Awakened wants you to speak with Rilak the Redeemed in the Lower City district of Shattrath.

records.name: Fel Spirits
records.objectives_text: Klatu in Honor Hold wants you to use the Anchorite Relic at Gor'gaz Outpost southwest of Honor Hold, slay Shattered Hand Berserkers near the relic, and then slay 10 released Fel Spirits to avenge Colonel Jules.

records.name: Death's Door
records.objectives_text: Wildlord Antelarion has implored you to travel to Death's Door. Once you arrive there, use the Druid Signal to call down an Evergrove Druid so that you can speak with them.

records.name: Fire At Will!
records.objectives_text: Use the Naturalized Ammunition to take control of the Death's Door Fel Cannons. Use them to destroy both the South Warp-Gate and the North Warp-Gate. Then, use the Druid Signal to call out to an Evergrove Druid to report your success.

records.name: The Hound-Master
records.objectives_text: The Evergrove Druid has has told you that the final thing you must do is to slay Baelmon the Hound-Master. Afterward, return to Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains, and inform Wildlord Antelarion of your success.

records.name: An Improper Burial
records.objectives_text: Commander Ra'vaj at the Sha'tari Outpost in the Bone Wastes of Terokkar Forest wants you to burn 8 Slain Auchenai Warriors and 8 Slain Sha'tar Vindicators.

records.name: A Hero Is Needed
records.objectives_text: Commander Ra'vaj at the Sha'tari Outpost in the Bone Wastes of Terokkar Forest wants you to slay 12 Auchenai Initiates and 5 Auchenai Doomsayers.

records.name: The Fallen Exarch
records.objectives_text: Commander Ra'vaj at the Sha'tari Outpost in the Bone Wastes of Terokkar Forest wants you to destroy the contents of the Auchenai Coffin.

objectives.text: Contents of the Auchenai Coffin destroyed

records.name: Digging for Prayer Beads
records.objectives_text: Recover the Draenei Prayer Beads and bring them to Assistant Klatu in Honor Hold.

records.name: The Outcast's Plight
records.objectives_text: Bring 30 Arakkoa Feathers to Vekax in Shattrath's Lower City.

records.name: For the Fallen
records.objectives_text: Vindicator Haylen wants you to slay 20 Dreadfang Widows and then return to him just west of Netherweb Ridge.

records.name: Terokkarantula
records.objectives_text: Vindicator Haylen wants you to kill the Terokkarantula and then return to him west of Netherweb Ridge.

records.name: Digging Through Bones
records.objectives_text: Escort Letoll and his crew and protect them while they make their dig. Return to Dwarfowitz at the Sha'tari Outpost if you succeed.

records.name: Evil Draws Near
records.objectives_text: Oakun wants you to take the Dread Relic to the Writhing Mound. Once there, kill Auchenai Death-Speakers and Auchenai Doomsayers to collect 20 Doom Skulls. Then find the Writhing Mound Summoning Circle and use the Dread Relic to summon and destroy Teribus the Cursed. Return to Oakun when the deed is done.

records.name: Bloody Imp-ossible!
records.objectives_text: Bring 8 vials of Warp Chaser Blood to Sab'aoth at Cosmowrench.

records.name: Return to Sha'tari Base Camp
records.objectives_text: Vindicator Haylen wants you to return to Sha'tari Base Camp and speak with Scout Navrin.

records.name: Killing the Crawlers
records.objectives_text: Sentinel Moonwhisper at the tunnel between Zangarmarsh and Blade's Edge Mountains wants you to kill 6 Cavern Crawlers and report to Commander Skyshadow in Sylvanaar.

records.name: Killing the Crawlers
records.objectives_text: Grunt Grahk at the tunnel between Zangarmarsh and Blade's Edge Mountains wants you to kill 6 Cavern Crawlers and report to Tor'chunk Two-claws in Thunderlord Stronghold.

records.name: Fumping
records.objectives_text: Dwarfowitz at the Sha'tari Base Camp in the Bone Wastes wants you to bring him 8 Mature Bone Sifter Carcasses.

records.name: The Big Bone Worm
records.objectives_text: Dwarfowitz at the Sha'tari Base Camp in the Bone Wastes wants you to recover Enormous Bone Worm Organs. He wants his Fumper back too.

records.name: The Exorcism of Colonel Jules
records.objectives_text: Speak with Anchorite Barada. Use the prayer beads to help with the ritual, and then speak with Colonel Jules when he is saved. Finally, return to Assistant Klatu.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Fel Spirits and Digging for Prayer Beads

records.name: Trollbane is Looking for You
records.objectives_text: Assistant Klatu has informed you that Force Commander Danath Trollbane has been seeking you. Speak to him in the barracks at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

records.name: Drill the Drillmaster
records.objectives_text: Force Commander Danath Trollbane has ordered you to kill Drillmaster Zurok with all due haste. Return to the force commander at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula once the drillmaster is dead.

records.name: Children's Week
records.objectives_text: Use the Blood Elf Orphan Whistle to call for the ward that you will be looking after during Children's Week.

records.name: Children's Week
records.objectives_text: Use the Draenei Orphan Whistle to call for the ward that you will be looking after during Children's Week.

records.name: The Secret Compromised
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Warden's Cage in Shadowmoon Valley and speak to Akama.

records.name: Hch'uu and the Mushroom People
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Salandria, to Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Then, speak with Hch'uu.

records.name: Ruse of the Ashtongue
records.objectives_text: Travel into Tempest Keep and slay Al'ar while wearing the Ashtongue Cowl. Return to Akama in Shadowmoon Valley once you've completed this task.

records.name: An Artifact From the Past
records.objectives_text: Go to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and gain access to the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Once inside, defeat Rage Winterchill and bring the Time-Phased Phylactery to Akama in Shadowmoon Valley.

records.name: The Hostage Soul
records.objectives_text: Travel to Shattrath City to tell A'dal about Akama's request.

records.name: Entry Into the Black Temple
records.objectives_text: Travel to the entrance to the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley and speak to Xi'ri.

records.name: Auchindoun and the Ring of Observance
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Dornaa, to the Meeting Stone at the Ring of Observance in the middle of Auchindoun. Auchindoun, in turn, is in the middle of Terokkar Forest's Bone Wastes. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive.

objectives.text: Dornaa taken to the Ring of Observance

coord_source.page: Auchindoun and the Ring of Observance

wiki.page: Auchindoun and the Ring of Observance

records.name: A Trip to the Dark Portal
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Salandria, up the steps of the Stair of Destiny to stand before the Dark Portal in Hellfire Peninsula. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive.

objectives.text: Salandria taken to the Dark Portal

wiki.page: A Trip to the Dark Portal (Horde)

records.name: A Trip to the Dark Portal
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Dornaa, up the steps of the Stair of Destiny to stand before the Dark Portal in Hellfire Peninsula. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive.

objectives.text: Dornaa taken to the Dark Portal

wiki.page: A Trip to the Dark Portal (Alliance)

records.name: Visit the Throne of the Elements
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Salandria, to the Throne of the Elements in Nagrand. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Then, speak with Elementalist Sharvak.

objectives.text: Salandria taken to the Throne of the Elements

wiki.page: Visit the Throne of the Elements

records.name: Jheel is at Aeris Landing!
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Dornaa, to Aeris Landing in Nagrand. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Then, speak with Jheel.

records.name: Morthis Whisperwing
records.objectives_text: Seek out Morthis Whisperwing at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

records.name: The Seat of the Naaru
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Dornaa, to stand before O'ros at the bottom of the Seat of the Naaru inside of the Exodar, which is on Azuremyst Isle. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Remember that you can use your map inside the city.

objectives.text: Dornaa taken to the Seat of the Naaru

prerequisites.wiki_text: Auchindoun and the Ring of Observance , A Trip to the Dark Portal (Alliance) , Jheel is at Aeris Landing!

records.name: Redemption of the Ashtongue
records.objectives_text: Help Akama wrest control back of his soul by defeating the Shade of Akama inside the Black Temple. Return to Seer Kanai when you've completed this task.

records.name: Seek Out the Ashtongue
records.objectives_text: Find Akama's Deathsworn inside the Black Temple.

records.name: The Fall of the Betrayer
records.objectives_text: Seer Kanai wants you to defeat Illidan inside the Black Temple.

records.name: The Ward of Wakening
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Bogblossoms, 10 Ancient Lichen, and 10 Dreaming Glory to Morthis Whisperwing at the Cenarion Refuge.

records.name: Time to Visit the Caverns
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Dornaa, to stand before Zaladormu, the dragon on the dais in the middle of the Caverns of Time. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Then, purchase a Toy Dragon for her from the Keepers of Time Quartermaster, Alurmi, near the bottom of the entrance tunnel.

objectives.text: Dornaa taken to the Caverns of Time

prerequisites.wiki_text: Auchindoun and the Ring of Observance , A Trip to the Dark Portal (Alliance) , Jheel is at Aeris Landing!

records.name: Time to Visit the Caverns
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Salandria, to stand before Zaladormu, the dragon on the dais in the middle of the Caverns of Time. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Then, purchase a Toy Dragon for her from the Keepers of Time Quartermaster, Alurmi, near the bottom of the entrance tunnel.

objectives.text: Salandria taken to the Caverns of Time

prerequisites.wiki_text: Hch'uu and the Mushroom People , A Trip to the Dark Portal (Horde) , and Visit the Throne of the Elements

records.name: Waking the Sleeper
records.objectives_text: Use the Ward of Waking to help Clintar Dreamwalker emerge from the Emerald Dream. When he is conscious, speak to him.

records.name: No Mere Dream
records.objectives_text: Protect Clintar Dreamwalker's Spirit while it gathers the relics of Aviana, then speak to Dreamwarden Lurosa.

objectives.text: Assist Clintar in gathering the relics

records.name: Back to the Orphanage
records.objectives_text: Return your ward to the Shattrath City orphanage by handing in the Draenei Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Mercy in the Lower City.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Call on the Farseer , Time to Visit the Caverns (Alliance)

records.name: Back to the Orphanage
records.objectives_text: Return your ward to the Shattrath City orphanage by handing in the Blood Elf Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Mercy in the Lower City.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Now, When I Grow Up... and Time to Visit the Caverns (Horde)

records.name: Call on the Farseer
records.objectives_text: Take your orphan, Dornaa, to visit Farseer Nobundo at the Crystal Hall inside of the Exodar, which is on Azuremyst Isle. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive. Remember that you can use your map inside the city.

records.name: Seek Out Ameer
records.objectives_text: Seek out Commander Ameer at the Protectorate Watch Post.

records.name: A Mission of Mercy
records.objectives_text: Recover the Salvaged Ethereum Prison Key for Commander Ameer at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm.

records.name: Ethereum Secrets
records.objectives_text: Commander Ameer at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm wants you to bring him an Ethereum Prisoner I.D. Tag.

records.name: A Thousand Worlds
records.objectives_text: Commander Ameer at the Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm wants you to bring him 5 Ethereum Prison Keys.

records.name: Stasis Chambers of Bash'ir
records.objectives_text: Use the Ethereum Key Tablet - Alpha to open Stasis Chamber Alpha at Bash'ir's Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains. Return Evidence from Alpha to the Image of Commander Ameer at Bash'ir's Landing.

records.name: The Mark of the Nexus-King
records.objectives_text: The Image of Commander Ameer at Bash'ir Landing in the Blade's Edge Mountains wants you to bring him a Mark of the Nexus-King.

records.name: Stasis Chambers of the Mana-Tombs
records.objectives_text: The Image of Commander Ameer at Bash'ir's Landing in the Blade's Edge Mountains wants you to use the Mana-Tombs Stasis Chamber Key on the Stasis Chamber inside the Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun. This quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

records.name: Return to Morthis Whisperwing
records.objectives_text: Bring the Relics of Aviana to Morthis Whisperwing at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

records.name: To the Evergrove
records.objectives_text: Speak with Arthorn Windsong at the Evergrove in Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Book of the Raven
records.objectives_text: Use an :Aether Ray Eye with your Seer's Stone to reveal the raven cult ghosts. Search the Vortex Pinnacle for the spirit of Sai'kkal the Elder and question him about the book of the raven, then return to Arthorn Windsong.

objectives.text: Learn about the Book of the Raven

records.name: Mog'dorg the Wizened
records.objectives_text: Visit Mog'dorg the Wizened atop the tower where Chort is standing, just outside the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Speak with the Ogre
records.objectives_text: Speak with the Ogre, Grok, in the Lower City section of Shattrath City.

records.name: A Distraction for Akama
records.objectives_text: Ensure that Akama and Maiev enter the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley after Xi'ri's forces create a distraction.

objectives.text: Help Akama and Maiev enter the Black Temple.

records.name: Eyes in the Sky
records.objectives_text: Speak with Watcher Elaira at the Twilight Ridge in Nagrand.

records.name: To Catch A Sparrowhawk
records.objectives_text: Use the Sparrowhawk Net to capture a Wild Sparrowhawk and bring it to Watcher Elaira on the Twilight Ridge.

records.name: The Raven Stones
records.objectives_text: Gather 8 Raven Stones from Skettis and bring them to Arthorn Windsong at Evergrove in Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Mog'dorg the Wizened
records.objectives_text: Visit Mog'dorg the Wizened atop one of the towers just outside the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Eagle's Essence
records.objectives_text: Defeat the Guardian of the Eagle and obtain the Essence of the Eagle. Use Arthorn's Sparrowhawk Whistle to call Arthorn's Sparrowhawk to relay news of your success. If you lose Arthorn's Sparrowhawk Whistle, return to Arthorn Windsong at the Evergrove for a replacement.

records.name: The Falcon's Essence
records.objectives_text: Defeat the Guardian of the Falcon, obtain the Essence of the Falcon. Use Arthorn's Sparrowhawk Whistle to call Arthorn's Sparrowhawk to relay news of your success. If you lose Arthorn's Sparrowhawk Whistle, return to Arthorn Windsong at the Evergrove for a replacement.

records.name: The Hawk's Essence
records.objectives_text: Defeat the Guardian of the Hawk and bring the Essence of the Hawk to Arthorn Windsong at Evergrove.

records.name: Return to Cenarion Refuge
records.objectives_text: Bring Arthorn's Package to Morthis Whisperwing at Cenarion Refuge.

records.name: Chasing the Moonstone
records.objectives_text: Bring a Southfury Moonstone to Morthis Whisperwing at the Cenarion Refuge.

records.name: Grulloc Has Two Skulls
records.objectives_text: Retrieve Grulloc's Dragon Skull and deliver it to Mog'dorg the Wizened atop the tower at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Maggoc's Treasure Chest
records.objectives_text: Retrieve Maggoc's Treasure Chest and deliver it to Mog'dorg the Wizened atop the tower at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Even Gronn Have Standards
records.objectives_text: Retrieve Slaag's Standard and deliver it to Mog'dorg the Wizened atop the tower at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: Grim(oire) Business
records.objectives_text: You must retrieve Vim'gol's Vile Grimoire. Deliver it to Mog'dorg the Wizened atop the tower at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Grulloc Has Two Skulls , Maggoc's Treasure Chest (quest) , and Even Gronn Have Standards

records.name: One Shot, One Kill
records.objectives_text: Bring me 8 trogg stone teeth.
